name: inhouse_confluence_mcp
description: An MCP server implementation for interacting with self-hosted Confluence Data Center or Server instances via search, content retrieval, and optional write operations. It features space auto-discovery, audit logging, and granular access control for secure enterprise collaboration.

rawRecord.description: An MCP server implementation for interacting with self-hosted Confluence Data Center or Server instances via search, content retrieval, and optional write operations. It features space auto-discovery, audit logging, and granular access control for secure enterprise collaboration.

DENIED_SPACES.description: Optional comma-separated list of space keys to explicitly block.

WRITE_ENABLED.description: Whether to enable tools that perform write operations (e.g., create_page, update_page).

ALLOWED_SPACES.description: Comma-separated list of Confluence space keys that are allowed to be accessed.

AUDIT_LOG_PATH.description: The file path where audit logs should be written.

CONFLUENCE_PAT.description: Personal Access Token for Confluence authentication.

PYTHONIOENCODING.description: Encoding for Python IO, typically set to 'utf-8'.

EXPERIMENTAL_LIKES.description: Whether to enable the experimental confluence_get_likes tool.

CONFLUENCE_BASE_URL.description: The base URL of the Confluence Data Center or Server instance.

AUTO_DISCOVER_SPACES.description: If true and ALLOWED_SPACES is empty, the server will auto-load available space keys on startup.

CONFLUENCE_AUTH_MODE.description: The authentication mode to use: 'pat' (Personal Access Token) or 'basic' (Username/Password).

TOOL_PROBE_ON_STARTUP.description: Whether the server should probe API permissions at startup to expose only reachable tools.

SPACE_PROBE_ON_STARTUP.description: Whether the server should probe space permissions at startup.

CONFLUENCE_MCP_ENV_FILE.description: Path to a custom environment file to load configurations from.
